import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { testApp } from "./helpers.ts";

it("exports the added loan feature, bounded pagination and borrower-private response contracts [QLT-01, QLT-06]", async () => {
  const { app, db } = await testApp();
  try {
    const document = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(app.swagger()));
    const routes = document.paths;
    expect(routes["/api/items"].get.security).toEqual([{ session: [] }]);
    expect(routes["/api/loans"].get.security).toEqual([{ session: [] }]);
    expect(routes["/api/items/{id}/reserve"].post.security).toEqual([{ session: [], csrf: [] }]);
    expect(routes["/api/loans/{id}/return"].post.security).toEqual([{ session: [], csrf: [] }]);
    expect(routes["/api/admin/loans"].get.description).toMatch(/admin/i);
    expect(routes["/api/admin/loans"].get.security).toEqual([{ session: [] }]);
    const parameters = routes["/api/items"].get.parameters;
    expect(parameters).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ name: "limit", in: "query", schema: expect.objectContaining({ minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 25 }) }));
    expect(parameters).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ name: "offset", in: "query", schema: expect.objectContaining({ minimum: 0, default: 0 }) }));
    const schema = (path: string) => routes[path].get.responses[200].content["application/json"].schema;
    expect(Object.keys(schema("/api/items").properties.items.items.properties).sort()).toEqual(["available", "id", "name"]);
    expect(Object.keys(schema("/api/loans").properties.items.items.properties).sort()).toEqual(["id", "itemId", "itemName", "reservedAt", "returnedAt"]);
    expect(schema("/api/loans").properties.items.items.properties.returnedAt).toMatchObject({ type: ["number", "null"] });
    expect(schema("/api/admin/loans").properties.items.items.properties.borrower.properties).toHaveProperty("email");
    expect(routes["/api/items/{id}/reserve"].post.parameters).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ name: "id", in: "path", required: true }));
    expect(routes["/api/items/{id}/reserve"].post.responses.default.content["application/json"].schema).toMatchObject({ properties: { correlationId: { type: "string" } } });
  } finally { await app.close(); db.close(); }
});
